title: CyberShield_Blockchain_Feature_Contract
description: Specifications for features derived from Hyperledger Fabric ledger events for future second-stage candidate re-ranking.

temporal_safety_rule.description: Strict causal invariant. No events occurring after the complaint or prediction trigger time may be incorporated.

features.name: verified_cashouts_1h
features.description: Count of confirmed ATM/branch cash-outs in candidate cluster within past 1 hour.

features.name: verified_cashouts_6h
features.description: Count of confirmed ATM/branch cash-outs in candidate cluster within past 6 hours.

features.name: verified_cashouts_24h
features.description: Count of confirmed ATM/branch cash-outs in candidate cluster within past 24 hours.

features.name: verified_attempts_1h
features.description: Count of attempted/failed withdrawals in candidate cluster within past 1 hour.

features.name: verified_attempts_6h
features.description: Count of attempted/failed withdrawals in candidate cluster within past 6 hours.

features.name: verified_attempts_24h
features.description: Count of attempted/failed withdrawals in candidate cluster within past 24 hours.

features.name: distinct_verifying_banks
features.description: Number of unique banking organizations verifying activity in this cluster (e.g. BankA, BankB, BankC).

features.name: distinct_verifying_orgs
features.description: Total unique consortium organizations (banks + I4C + LEA) submitting signals for this cluster.

features.name: linked_mule_activity_count
features.description: Number of mule activity signals connected to the opaque subject reference within 24 hours.

features.name: confirmed_cluster_recurrence
features.description: Count of LEA-confirmed cyber fraud incidents in this cluster over the past 7 days.

features.name: recent_cluster_velocity
features.description: Ratio of (verified cashouts in last 1 hour) / (average hourly rate in last 24 hours).

features.name: source_diversity_score
features.description: Entropy of signal sources across reporting consortium members (0.0 = single org, 1.0 = highly diversified).

features.name: multi_org_attestation_count
features.description: Count of signals co-endorsed by two or more independent organizations.

features.name: latest_verified_signal_age_minutes
features.description: Elapsed minutes since the most recent verified event in this cluster. Defaults to 9999.0 if none.

features.name: revoked_signal_count
features.description: Count of previously submitted signals subsequently revoked in this cluster.

features.name: corrected_signal_count
features.description: Count of signals amended with corrected spatial or financial parameters.

features.name: candidate_verified_signal_score
features.description: Normalized signal density score based on weighted confidence of active events.
